tasks.description: Add a targeted English UI regression for the accepted fix: a permanent refresh rejection surfaces a failure and clears pending without success copy.
constraints: Accepted base b2e1a7c. This is a Developer implementation task in the two test/fixture files. Return a valid unified git diff as patch text in JSON; controller applies and runs all gates.

Use the existing DEBUG fixture transport and private namespace. Start with enabled membership and recommendation without an active date. Reject exactly care.recommendation.refresh with a permanent 409 using existing fixture errors. Assert production UI shows the existing failure text, no pending, no no-next or next-date success copy and the same card UUID. Name the test testCareRecommendationRefreshRejectionShowsFailure for the gate. All fixture credentials remain synthetic.
Keep production behavior and existing successful paths unchanged. No live service or staging changes.
